# Monash Student Tools

> Guides for free tools for Monash University students, built by a Monash computer science student: Study Kit (Moodle and Ed in Claude or any MCP client), Monash Hub (units, degrees, WAM/GPA, Malaysia tuition fees, key dates, official guides), Ed Web (read and search Ed in a browser), Attendance Helper (Chrome extension) and a WeChat Q&A bot. Chinese versions of every page are under /zh-cn/.

If you are an AI agent asked to install something for a student, read the agent instructions first. Never ask for or accept the student's Ed token, Monash password or MFA code.

## Agent instructions

- [Set up Study Kit](https://docs.secureview.tech/agents/study-kit.md): install, hand over setup to the student, verify with monash doctor
- [Prepare Attendance Helper](https://docs.secureview.tech/agents/attendance.md): download and unzip the extension, hand over the Chrome steps

## Start here

- [Which tool do I need?](https://docs.secureview.tech/choose/): compare tools by task, install and where data goes
- [Let your AI set it up](https://docs.secureview.tech/ai-setup/): one line to paste into an AI that can run terminal commands

## Study Kit

- [Overview](https://docs.secureview.tech/study-kit/): connect Monash Moodle and Ed to Claude, Codex, Cursor or any local MCP app; everything stays on your computer
- [Install](https://docs.secureview.tech/study-kit/install/): one command installs uv and the monash command
- [First-time setup](https://docs.secureview.tech/study-kit/setup/): Ed token, Moodle login with MFA, units, connecting your AI app
- [What to ask your AI](https://docs.secureview.tech/study-kit/ask-claude/): example questions
- [Use it without AI](https://docs.secureview.tech/study-kit/cli/): the monash command in a terminal, and monash library to browse synced files
- [Other AI apps](https://docs.secureview.tech/study-kit/other-clients/): monash connect for Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Gemini CLI
- [Host it yourself](https://docs.secureview.tech/study-kit/remote/): optional single-user remote MCP server (1.4.0+) for ChatGPT and Claude on the web or phone, behind your own domain or a Cloudflare quick tunnel
- [Lecture recordings](https://docs.secureview.tech/study-kit/recordings/): timestamped transcripts your AI can search
- [Privacy and security](https://docs.secureview.tech/study-kit/privacy/): where data and credentials are kept, how to remove everything
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.secureview.tech/study-kit/troubleshooting/): start with monash doctor
- [Command reference](https://docs.secureview.tech/study-kit/commands/): every command, output formats, exit codes
- [Update and uninstall](https://docs.secureview.tech/study-kit/update/)

Install scripts: https://docs.secureview.tech/study-kit/install.sh (macOS, Linux) and https://docs.secureview.tech/study-kit/install.ps1 (Windows). Both accept a no-setup mode (`--no-setup` or `MONASH_NO_SETUP=1`).

## Monash Hub

- [Monash Hub](https://docs.secureview.tech/monash-hub/): units, degrees, course maps, WAM and GPA, Malaysia tuition fees, key dates and official guides, in English and Simplified Chinese
- [Add to home screen](https://docs.secureview.tech/monash-hub/app/)

## Ed Web

- [Ed Web](https://docs.secureview.tech/ed-web/): read and search an Ed forum in the browser, download lesson files

## Attendance Helper

- [Overview](https://docs.secureview.tech/attendance/): finds attendance codes, submits only classes the student confirms
- [Install](https://docs.secureview.tech/attendance/install/)
- [Use](https://docs.secureview.tech/attendance/use/)

## WeChat Q&A bot

- [WeChat Q&A bot](https://docs.secureview.tech/wechat-bot/): answers from official pages with sources, says so when it does not know
